title: Wine Brown Embroidered Cotton Tunic Top for Women – Short Kurti
color_custom: Deep wine brown with white embroidery
description:
The piece you will reach for every week. A deep wine-brown cotton tunic, framed with crisp white floral embroidery at the neckline, cuffs and hem. It turns plain jeans into an outfit and works just as well with trousers or palazzos.

✦ The Details
• Notched V neckline outlined in white floral embroidery
• 3/4 sleeves with wide embroidered cuffs
• Bold embroidered border at the hem
• Hip length with short side slits
• Easy pull-on style

✦ Fabric & Craft
100% cotton – soft, breathable and easy to wash. The rich wine shade is dyed to last; wash separately the first few times.

✦ Fit & Size
Regular, easy fit. Choose your usual top size – size up if you prefer a looser, boxy look.

✦ How to Style It
Light blue flared jeans and clear heels for college or brunch; black straight trousers and a watch for office; a white palazzo and long silver jhumkas for a festive touch; a denim jacket on top for travel and cool evenings.

✦ The Bahe Promise
• Made in our own Jaipur unit – we send you photos of your piece being made
• Free custom fit – share your measurements and we stitch it for you
• Free worldwide shipping to the USA, UK, Canada, UAE & Australia, with tracking
• Real people on WhatsApp to help with size and styling

The colour may look slightly different on your screen. Model is wearing size S.
care: Gentle hand wash in cold water separately for the first wash. Do not bleach. Dry in shade and iron on medium heat on the reverse side.
